goal: Simulate the pre-registered combinations x exits X0 fixed 1R/2R, X1 all out at first opposing level, X2 ladder (1/2 at first level; rest held while CVD agrees, 1/2 of rest when CVD flat, all out on CVD against or opposite Bollinger band; time stop end of UTC day). Stop beyond level by max(0.10 %, 0.40 % taker / 0.20 % maker). Scale-in arms S0-S3 and stop arms K1-K5 per PLAN.md; R = loss if every planned fill happens and the stop is hit.
note: Operator idea 2026-10-14; own layer (research only until LC3 passes); numbers OURS, printed in each report.
scope_out: VALIDATION (2025-04..06) and HOLDOUT (2025-07+) bars, except card lc-validation
steps: Simulator with fees both ways (fees.py), partial fills accounted per leg.
Scale-in: S1 half at L1 + half at L2, one stop for the whole position set at entry; S0, S2, S3 on the SAME trade ideas; report net R per idea (unfilled halves count as zero), not per fill.
Stop table per arm: bad-stop rate, good-stop rate, net R after fees, fee share of R; the stop is chosen on net R.
Report per combination x exit: n, mean R after fees with 95 % CI, max drawdown, power / minimum detectable effect (gap-g1 helper). Below 50 % power a FAIL reads INCONCLUSIVE.
Freeze the single best DEV rule in frozen_rule.json (no edits after).
tests: hand-built price path: long at support, first resistance hit -> half closed there; CVD flat bar -> quarter closed; opposite band -> rest closed; fees subtracted per leg match a hand sum. Scale-in: path touching L1 then L2 then target -> two fills, average entry hand-computed, one stop beyond L2; path touching L1 then target -> half size win only; a stop hit then target -> counted BAD_STOP.
title: LC3 Levels Confluence: ladder-exit simulator (fixed vs first level vs CVD/Bollinger step-out) on the <= 6 LC2 combinations, DEV, maker+taker fees
